correctness.rationale: For a solid right circular cylinder r,h>0 the unlabelled Haar plane normal has X=|U·e_3| uniform on [0,1]. Minkowski sum of projected disk and axial segment has exact area A=πr²X+2rh√(1−X²). Direct beta integrals establish stated m1,m2,m3; putting y=h/(r+h), equality of q2=m2/m1² is either y=z or reflection y+z=s=2π(π−2)/(π²−4π+8). On reflected pairs the divided difference (q3(y)−q3(z))/(y−z) is strictly negative: an explicit upper bound is 12 f(π)/(π(π²−4π+8)²), f(p)=p⁴−6p³+4p²+36p−64, f(π)<0 by rational bounds 157/50<π<22/7 and positive f′ over that interval. Thus the third raw moment separates every nonidentical second-moment pair, while second-moment two-branch ambiguity starts at t>(π²−8)/(4(4−π)), except the reflection vertex t=π(π−2)/(2(4−π)). Independent numerical quadrature over seven aspect ratios and exact symbolic identities confirmed normalization; not a general-body or statistical inference theorem.
